recipes.title: Grilled Whole Mackerel
steps: Slash the fish 3 times on each side. Brush with the butter and salt inside and out.
Grill under high heat or over coals for 5-6 minutes per side until the skin blisters and the flesh is opaque at the bone.

recipes.title: Seared Tuna Steaks
steps: Press the salt and pepper onto both sides of the tuna.
Sear in very hot ghee for 1 minute per side, leaving the middle raw.
Slice thickly.

recipes.title: Garlic-Free Butter Shrimp
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and salt them.
Fry in foaming butter over high heat for 1-2 minutes per side until pink and curled.

recipes.title: Seared Scallops in Brown Butter
steps: Dry the scallops very well and salt them.
Sear in a little butter in a very hot pan for 90 seconds per side without moving them.
Lift out, add the rest of the butter, cook until nutty and pour over.

recipes.title: Steamed Mussels in Butter
steps: Discard any mussels that stay open when tapped.
Bring the water and butter to the boil in a wide pot, add the mussels, cover and steam for 4-5 minutes, shaking the pot, until they open.
Throw away any that stay closed. Spoon the buttery juices over.

recipes.title: Pan-Fried Sardines
steps: Salt the sardines and leave 10 minutes.
Fry in hot lard 2-3 minutes per side until crisp.

recipes.title: Salmon Egg Scramble
steps: Beat the eggs with the salt.
Melt the butter over low heat, add the eggs and stir slowly.
When almost set, fold in the salmon and warm through.

recipes.title: Crab and Butter Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with the salt.
Melt the butter in a small pan until foaming, add the eggs and stir quickly, then let them set.
Spoon the crab over one half, fold and slide onto a plate.

recipes.title: Shrimp and Egg Custard Cups
steps: Beat the eggs with the broth and salt, without making foam. Strain.
Divide the shrimp between 4 heatproof cups and pour over the egg.
Cover and steam over gentle heat for 12-15 minutes until just set.

recipes.title: Soft-Boiled Eggs with Butter
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for 6½ minutes. Cool briefly in cold water and peel.
Halve onto plates and top with the butter and salt.

recipes.title: Cheese Crisp Egg Cups
steps: Make 4 small piles of cheese on a lined tray and bake at 200 °C for 5 minutes until lacy. Lift onto upturned cups to set into bowls.
Bake the eggs in a greased muffin tin with the salt for 8-10 minutes.
Set each egg in a cheese cup.

recipes.title: Steak and Eggs
steps: Salt the steak and sear in a hot pan for 3-4 minutes per side. Rest while you cook the eggs.
Fry the eggs in the butter in the same pan.
Slice the steak and serve with the eggs and pepper.

recipes.title: Egg Yolk Butter Sauce
steps: Melt the butter and keep it warm.
Whisk the yolks and water in a bowl over barely simmering water until thick and pale.
Take off the heat and whisk in the butter a little at a time. Season with the salt. Use right away.

recipes.title: Brown Butter
steps: Melt the butter in a light-coloured pan over medium heat, swirling.
Keep cooking as it foams; when the specks on the bottom turn hazelnut brown and it smells nutty, pour into a cold bowl.
Add the salt. Keeps a week in the fridge. Finish with the black pepper.

recipes.title: Rendered Beef Tallow
steps: Put the suet and water in a heavy pot over low heat. Let it melt slowly for 2-3 hours, stirring now and then, until the bits are golden and crisp.
Strain through a fine sieve into clean jars. It sets white and keeps for months in the fridge. Finish with the black pepper.

recipes.title: Home-Rendered Lard
steps: Melt the pork fat with the water over very low heat for 2-3 hours, stirring now and then.
Strain into jars when the pieces are golden. Keep the crisp pieces, salted, as a snack. Finish with the black pepper.

recipes.title: Bone Marrow Butter
steps: Roast the bones at 220 °C for 15 minutes. Scoop out the marrow and let it cool.
Mash with the butter and salt until smooth.
Roll in baking paper and chill. Slice onto hot steaks.

recipes.title: Cream and Pan-Juice Sauce
steps: After cooking meat, pour off most of the fat, add the stock and scrape up the browned bits.
Boil until reduced by half, add the cream and simmer until it coats a spoon.
Whisk in the butter and salt.

recipes.title: Parmesan Chicken Cutlets
steps: Season the chicken with salt. Dip in beaten egg, then press into the parmesan.
Fry in the lard over medium heat for 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.

recipes.title: Pork Rind Crusted Fish
steps: Salt the fish, dip in the beaten egg, then press into the crushed pork rinds.
Fry in the lard 3-4 minutes per side until golden and flaky.

recipes.title: Venison Steaks with Butter
steps: Salt the venison and bring to room temperature.
Sear in a very hot pan 2-3 minutes per side. Add the butter and baste for 1 minute.
Rest 5 minutes; venison is best pink.

recipes.title: Oxtail Braised in Bone Broth
steps: Salt the oxtail and brown it well in the tallow.
Add the broth, cover and simmer gently for 3-3½ hours until the meat falls off the bone.
Skim the fat and reduce the sauce to coat.

recipes.title: Beef Jerky-Style Oven Strips, Salt Only

ingredients.name: Beef roast, top round, partly frozen

steps: Slice the beef 3-4 mm thick with the grain. Toss with the salt and leave 1 hour.
Lay the strips on racks over trays. Dry in the oven at 75 °C with the door propped open for 3-4 hours until leathery but still bendable.
Cool and keep in a jar in the fridge for 2 weeks. Finish with the black pepper.

recipes.title: Pork Rind Snack
steps: Simmer the skin for 1 hour, scrape off any fat underneath and cut into 4 cm pieces.
Dry on a rack at 90 °C for 2 hours until hard.
Fry a few at a time in hot lard until they puff. Drain and salt.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon and Cream Cheese Rolls
steps: Lay out the salmon slices slightly overlapping.
Spread thinly with the cream cheese, roll up tightly and chill 20 minutes.
Slice into rounds and finish with the pepper.

recipes.title: Lamb Liver with Brown Butter
steps: Pat the liver dry.
Fry in foaming butter over high heat for about 1 minute per side.
Season with the salt and pour over the browned butter.

recipes.title: Danish Rye Open Sandwich with Egg and Shrimp
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and slice.
Butter the rye bread right to the edges.
Mix the mayonnaise with the lemon juice. Lay the egg slices on the bread, pile the shrimp on top, add a spoon of the lemon mayonnaise and finish with dill.

recipes.title: Danish Meatballs with Potatoes (Frikadeller)
steps: Mix the pork, onion, egg, flour, milk, salt and pepper into a soft mixture. Rest it 15 minutes.
Boil the potatoes in salted water until tender, about 20 minutes.
Shape oval patties with a wet spoon and fry them in the butter over medium heat, 5-6 minutes per side, until cooked through. Serve with the potatoes.

recipes.title: Danish Rice Pudding with Cherry Sauce
steps: Simmer the rice in the milk over low heat, stirring often, for 40 minutes until thick. Stir in the vanilla and sugar and cool completely.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold it into the cold rice with the almonds.
Heat the cherries with 100 ml water. Mix the cornstarch with a little cold water, stir it in and simmer until glossy. Serve warm over the pudding.

recipes.title: Danish Red Cabbage
steps: Melt the butter in a large pot and stir in the cabbage.
Add the vinegar, sugar, apple, salt and 100 ml water. Cover and cook gently for 50-60 minutes, stirring now and then.
Uncover for the last 10 minutes so the liquid cooks down. Taste for sweet and sour balance.

recipes.title: Finnish Salmon Soup (Lohikeitto)
steps: Soften the leek in the butter for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, carrot and stock and simmer 15 minutes until the potatoes are just tender.
Pour in the cream, add the salmon and salt and simmer gently 5 minutes until the fish flakes. Stir in plenty of dill.

recipes.title: Finnish Blueberry Pie
steps: Beat the butter with 100 g of the sugar, add 1 egg, then mix in the flour and baking powder. Press into a 24 cm pie dish and up the sides.
Spread the blueberries over the base.
Whisk the sour cream, the other egg, the rest of the sugar and the vanilla and pour over the berries. Bake at 200 °C for 25-30 minutes until set. Cool before slicing.

recipes.title: Finnish Oven Pancake (Pannukakku)
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, flour, sugar and salt to a thin batter. Rest 15 minutes.
Put the butter in a deep roasting tin and heat in the oven at 225 °C until sizzling.
Pour in the batter and bake 25-30 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve warm with jam or berries.

recipes.title: Finnish Karelian-Style Rice Pies
steps: Simmer the rice in 300 ml water until absorbed, add the milk and half the salt and cook gently 40 minutes to a thick porridge. Cool.
Mix both flours, the rest of the salt and the water to a firm dough. Roll into 12 very thin rounds.

Spread porridge in the middle of each, fold the edges in and pinch them. Bake at 275 °C (or as hot as your oven goes) for 12-15 minutes, brush with butter. Serve with chopped hard-boiled eggs mixed with butter.

recipes.title: Norwegian Lamb and Cabbage Stew

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, bone in, in chunks

steps: Layer the lamb and cabbage in a heavy pot, sprinkling each layer with salt, peppercorns and a little flour.
Pour in 500 ml water, bring to a boil, cover and simmer very gently for 2-2½ hours until the lamb is tender.
Serve with boiled potatoes.

recipes.title: Norwegian Waffles with Cardamom
steps: Whisk the eggs and sugar until pale.
Add the flour, cardamom and milk alternately and whisk smooth, then stir in the butter. Rest 15 minutes.
Cook in a hot greased waffle iron until golden. Serve with sour cream and jam.

recipes.title: Norwegian Fish Cakes
steps: Cut the fish in pieces and blend with the salt until sticky.
Blend in the cornstarch and nutmeg, then the milk a little at a time to a soft mixture.
Shape flat cakes with wet hands and fry in the butter for 3-4 minutes per side. Serve with potatoes and carrots.

recipes.title: Chilean Corn and Beef Casserole (Pastel de Choclo)
steps: Fry the onions in a little oil until soft, add the beef, cumin, paprika and half the salt and cook through. Spread in a baking dish and top with sliced eggs and olives.
Blend the corn with the milk and basil, then cook in the butter with the rest of the salt, stirring, until thick, about 10 minutes.
Spread the corn over the meat, sprinkle with the sugar and bake at 200 °C for 30 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Chilean Tomato and Onion Salad (Ensalada Chilena)
steps: Slice the onion very thinly and soak it in cold salted water for 10 minutes to soften the bite. Drain.
Peel and slice the tomatoes.
Toss with the onion, oil, salt and chopped cilantro.

recipes.title: Chilean Bean and Squash Stew (Porotos Granados)
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, stir in the paprika.
Add the squash and 500 ml water and simmer 20 minutes until the squash starts to break up.
Add the beans, corn and salt and simmer 10 minutes more. Stir in torn basil.

recipes.title: Guatemalan Chicken in Tomato and Pepper Sauce (Pepián-Style)
steps: Simmer the chicken in 1 litre water with half the salt for 30 minutes. Keep the broth.
Dry-toast the seeds and chili in a pan, then char the tomatoes, pepper, onion and garlic in the same pan.
Blend everything with 400 ml of the broth, pour over the chicken, add the cinnamon and the rest of the salt and simmer 20 minutes until thick. Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Guatemalan Black Bean Purée (Frijoles Volteados)
steps: Fry the onion in the oil until soft.
Add the beans with their liquid and the salt and mash in the pan.
Cook, stirring, until the purée is thick enough to pull away from the pan, about 15 minutes. Serve with eggs and tortillas.

recipes.title: Guatemalan Cabbage Slaw (Curtido)
steps: Pour boiling water over the cabbage, leave 1 minute and drain well.
Mix with the carrot, onion, vinegar, oregano, salt and 100 ml water.
Chill at least 2 hours. Keeps a week in the fridge.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Red Red (Black-Eyed Pea Stew)
steps: Cook the onion in half the palm oil until soft. Add the ginger, tomatoes and whole pepper and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the peas, salt and 200 ml water and simmer 10 minutes. Remove the pepper.
Slice the ripe plantains and fry them in the rest of the oil until caramelised. Serve with the stew.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Peanut Soup with Chicken
steps: Simmer the chicken, half the onion, ginger and salt in 1.5 litres water for 20 minutes.
Blend the tomatoes with the rest of the onion and add to the pot with the whole pepper.
Whisk the peanut butter with a ladle of the broth and stir it in. Simmer 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until the oil rises. Serve with rice balls.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Spiced Plantain Bites (Kelewele)
steps: Peel the plantains and cut into small cubes.
Toss with the ginger, onion, cayenne and salt. Leave 10 minutes.
Fry in hot oil in batches until deep golden. Drain and serve hot.

recipes.title: Lahori-Style Chicken Karahi with Ginger
steps: Brown the chicken in the hot oil in a wok or wide pan, 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and half the ginger, then the tomatoes, salt and spices. Cook over high heat, stirring, until the tomatoes break down and the oil separates, 20 minutes.
Add the chilies and the rest of the ginger, cook 5 minutes and finish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Pakistani Lentils with Spinach (Daal Palak)
steps: Simmer the lentils in 800 ml water with the turmeric for 20 minutes until soft.
Stir in the spinach and salt and cook 5 minutes.
Fry the cumin seeds, onion and garlic in the ghee until golden and pour over the daal.

recipes.title: Pakistani Spiced Potato Fritters (Aloo Pakora)
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, spices and salt with about 150 ml water to a thick coating batter.
Dip the potato slices in the batter.
Fry in hot oil in batches until crisp and golden, 3-4 minutes. Drain and serve with chutney.

recipes.title: Pakistani Rice Pudding (Kheer)
steps: Bring the milk to a boil, add the drained rice and simmer on low, stirring often, for 50 minutes until thick and creamy.
Stir in the sugar and cardamom and cook 5 minutes.
Serve warm or cold with pistachios.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Dhal Curry (Parippu)
steps: Simmer the lentils with half the onion, the garlic, turmeric and 500 ml water for 15 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and salt and simmer 5 minutes.
Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves, chili and the rest of the onion in the coconut oil until golden and stir into the dhal.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Coconut Sambol (Pol Sambol)
steps: If using dried coconut, soak it in 4 tbsp warm water for 10 minutes.
Pound or rub the onion, chili and salt together until juicy.
Mix in the coconut and lime juice with your fingers until pink. Serve with rice and curry.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Roasted-Spice Chicken Curry
steps: Toast the curry powder in a dry pan until it darkens a shade.
Fry the onion, garlic, ginger, curry leaves and cinnamon in the oil until golden. Add the chicken, curry powder and salt and stir to coat.
Add 200 ml water, cover and simmer 25 minutes, then add the coconut milk and simmer uncovered 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Green Bean Coconut Stir-Fry
steps: Fry the mustard seeds and curry leaves in the oil until they pop. Add the onion and soften.
Add the beans, turmeric, salt and 3 tbsp water and stir-fry 6-8 minutes until tender-crisp.
Stir in the coconut and cook 1 minute.

recipes.title: Nepali Steamed Dumplings (Momo)
steps: Mix the flour with about 160 ml water to a smooth dough. Rest 20 minutes.
Mix the chicken, onion, grated garlic and ginger, cilantro, cumin and salt.
Roll small thin rounds, fill, pleat closed and steam on an oiled rack for 12-15 minutes. Serve with tomato chutney.

recipes.title: Nepali Lentil Soup (Dal)
steps: Simmer the lentils with the turmeric, ginger and 1 litre water for 25 minutes until soft. Whisk to break up and add the salt.
Fry the cumin and garlic in the ghee until golden.
Pour into the dal, cover for a minute and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Nepali Potato Salad with Sesame (Aloo Achar)
steps: Boil the potatoes until just tender, peel and cube.
Toast and grind the sesame. Mix with the chili, salt, lemon juice and potatoes.
Fry the fenugreek seeds in the oil until dark, add the turmeric, pour over the potatoes, toss and add cilantro.

recipes.title: Burmese Ginger Salad
steps: Soak the ginger in the lime juice for 10 minutes.
Toss the cabbage and tomatoes with the ginger and its juice, fish sauce and oil.
Top with peanuts and sesame just before serving.

recipes.title: Burmese Coconut Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Blend the onion, garlic and ginger and fry the paste in a little oil until golden. Add the turmeric, paprika and chicken and cook 5 minutes.
Add 1 litre water and simmer 20 minutes. Whisk the chickpea flour with a little water and stir in with the coconut milk and fish sauce; simmer 10 minutes.
Cook the noodles, divide among bowls and ladle the soup over. Top with halved eggs.

recipes.title: Burmese Pork Curry with Ginger
steps: Blend the onions, garlic and ginger to a paste.
Fry the paste in the oil with the paprika and turmeric over medium heat until the oil separates, 10 minutes.
Add the pork, soy sauce and 400 ml water, cover and simmer 75 minutes until tender, uncovering at the end to thicken.

recipes.title: Taiwanese Braised Pork Rice
steps: Fry the shallots in a little oil until crisp and golden. Add the pork and cook until the fat runs.
Add the garlic, soy sauce, sugar, five spice, rice wine and 500 ml water. Add the peeled eggs.
Cover and simmer gently 1 hour. Cook the rice and spoon the pork and sauce over it with a halved egg.

recipes.title: Taiwanese Three-Cup Chicken
steps: Heat the sesame oil and fry the ginger and whole garlic cloves until golden.
Add the chicken and brown it, then add the soy sauce, rice wine and sugar.
Cover and cook 15 minutes, then uncover and reduce until sticky. Stir in the basil.

recipes.title: Taiwanese Popcorn Chicken
steps: Marinate the chicken in the soy sauce, rice wine, garlic and half the five spice for 20 minutes.
Toss in the potato starch and fry in hot oil in batches until crisp, 4-5 minutes.
Fry the basil leaves for a few seconds. Toss everything with the rest of the five spice and the white pepper.

recipes.title: Taiwanese Scallion Pancakes
steps: Mix the flour with the hot water to a soft dough. Knead 5 minutes and rest 30 minutes covered.
Divide in 4. Roll each thin, brush with oil, sprinkle with salt and green onions, roll up into a rope, coil it and roll flat again.
Fry in a little oil over medium heat 3 minutes per side until crisp and flaky.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Beet Soup (Borscht)
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in a little oil, add the beets, tomato paste and vinegar and cook 10 minutes.
Add the stock and potatoes and simmer 15 minutes, then the cabbage for 15 minutes more.
Season, rest 10 minutes and serve with sour cream and dill.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Potato Dumplings (Varenyky)
steps: Mix the flour, egg, water and a pinch of salt to a soft dough. Rest 30 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes. Fry the onion in the butter until golden; mix half into the potatoes with the cheese and salt.
Roll the dough thin, cut 7 cm rounds, fill and seal. Boil in salted water until they float plus 2 minutes. Serve with the rest of the onion and sour cream.

recipes.title: Uzbek Lamb and Carrot Rice (Plov)
steps: Brown the lamb in the hot oil in a heavy pot, add the onions and cook until golden, then the carrots, cumin and salt for 10 minutes.
Add water just to cover and simmer 40 minutes.

Spread the rice on top without stirring, add water to 1.5 cm above the rice and push the garlic cloves into it. Cook uncovered until the water is absorbed, then cover tightly and cook on very low heat 25 minutes. Mix before serving.

recipes.title: Uzbek Tomato and Cucumber Salad (Achichuk)
steps: Salt the onion and squeeze it gently, then rinse.
Layer the tomatoes, cucumber and onion.
Season with salt and pepper and scatter cilantro. Serve with plov.

recipes.title: Ecuadorian Potato and Cheese Soup (Locro de Papa)
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in a little oil with the cumin and paprika.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer 25 minutes, mashing some potatoes to thicken.
Stir in the milk and crumbled cheese and heat through. Serve with avocado slices.

recipes.title: Ecuadorian Shrimp Ceviche
steps: Boil the shrimp for 1-2 minutes until just pink and cool in iced water.
Soak the onion in lime juice with a pinch of salt. Blend 2 tomatoes with the orange juice and ketchup.
Mix the shrimp, onion with its lime, the tomato mix, the other 2 tomatoes chopped, salt and cilantro. Chill 30 minutes. Serve with popcorn or plantain chips.

recipes.title: Tallow-Grilled Ribeye
steps: Heat a grill or griddle pan until very hot. Brush the steak with the melted tallow and salt it well.
Grill 5 minutes on each side for medium-rare, turning once; a thermometer should read 54 °C in the thickest part.
Rest 5 minutes on a warm plate, then slice across the grain and season with the pepper.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Ribeye
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 200 °C for 5 minutes. Pat the steak dry, brush with the butter and salt both sides.
Air fry for 5 minutes, turn and air fry 5 minutes more for medium-rare (54 °C inside). Thinner cuts need a minute or two less.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing across the grain.

recipes.title: Butter-Basted Sirloin
steps: Pat the steak dry and salt it on both sides 30 minutes ahead if you have time (or just before cooking).
Heat a heavy frying pan over high heat until smoking. Cook the steak 3 minutes on the first side without moving it.
Turn it, add the butter and, as it foams, tilt the pan and spoon the butter over the steak for 3 minutes for medium-rare (54 °C inside), longer if you like it more done.
Rest the steak 5 minutes, slice across the grain and pour over the pan butter. Finish with the pepper.

Rest the steak 5 minutes, slice across the grain and pour over the pan butter. Finish with the pepper.

recipes.title: Tallow-Grilled Bavette
steps: Heat a grill or griddle pan until very hot. Brush the steak with the melted tallow and salt it well.
Grill 4 minutes on each side for medium-rare, turning once; a thermometer should read 54 °C in the thickest part.
Rest 5 minutes on a warm plate, then slice across the grain and season with the pepper.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Bavette
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 200 °C for 5 minutes. Pat the steak dry, brush with the butter and salt both sides.
Air fry for 4 minutes, turn and air fry 4 minutes more for medium-rare (54 °C inside). Thinner cuts need a minute or two less.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing across the grain.

recipes.title: Pan-Fried Pork Chops in Butter

ingredients.name: Pork chops, bone-in, about 2 cm thick

steps: Salt the chops and leave 15 minutes. Pat dry.
Fry in a hot pan for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden and 63 °C inside, adding the butter for the last 2 minutes and spooning it over.
Rest 3 minutes and season with pepper.

recipes.title: Lamb Chops with Browned Butter
steps: Salt the chops. Stand them fat side down in a hot dry pan for 2 minutes to render the fat.
Lay them flat and cook 3 minutes per side for pink.
Lift out, add the butter and cook until nutty brown, then pour over the chops with the pepper.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Lamb Chops
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 200 °C. Salt the chops.
Air fry 5 minutes, turn and air fry 4 to 5 minutes more for pink (58 °C).
Rest 3 minutes and add the pepper.

recipes.title: Slow-Roasted Pork Shoulder with Crackling

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, skin on and scored

steps: Dry the skin well and rub the salt into the scores. Leave uncovered in the fridge overnight if you can.
Roast at 160 °C with the water in the tin for 4½ hours, topping up the water if it dries.
Turn the oven to 230 °C for 20 to 30 minutes until the skin crackles all over.
Rest 20 minutes, then pull or slice.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork Shoulder
steps: Rub the pork all over with the salt and pepper.
Put it in the slow cooker with the broth, cover and cook on Low for 8 hours until it pulls apart.
Shred with two forks and toss with some of the cooking juices.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Brisket
steps: Season the brisket. Brown it all over in the tallow in a hot pan.
Put it fat side up in the slow cooker with the stock. Cover and cook on Low for 9 hours until tender.
Rest 15 minutes, slice across the grain and spoon over the juices.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Short Ribs
steps: Salt the ribs and brown them in a hot dry pan, in batches.
Put them in the slow cooker with the broth. Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours.
Skim the fat from the juices and pour them over the ribs with the pepper.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Oxtail in Bone Broth
steps: Salt and brown the oxtail in a hot pan.
Put in the slow cooker with the broth. Cover and cook on Low for 9 hours.
Chill the juices briefly so the fat sets, lift it off and reheat the oxtail in the juices.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Pork Belly Bites

ingredients.name: Pork belly, cut into 3 cm cubes

steps: Put the pork and water in the pot. Lock the lid, set the valve to Sealing and pressure cook on High for 20 minutes.
Release the pressure naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release. Lift out the pork and pour off the liquid.
Select Sauté, return the pork with the salt and fry in its own fat, turning, for 10 minutes until crisp on all sides.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Thighs in Broth

ingredients.name: Chicken thighs, bone-in and skin on

steps: Salt the thighs. Select Sauté and brown them skin side down in the butter, in batches.
Pour in the broth and scrape the bottom clean, then return the chicken.
Lock the lid, set the valve to Sealing and pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. Natural release for 10 minutes, then release the rest.
Check they are 75 °C inside. Serve with the broth spooned over.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef Bone Broth
steps: Roast the bones at 220 °C for 30 minutes for a deeper flavour (optional).
Put the bones in the pot and add the water up to the max line. Lock the lid, set to Sealing and pressure cook on High for 2 hours.
Let the pressure release naturally. Strain, season with the salt and chill; lift off the fat to cook with.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Chicken Drumsticks
steps: Pat the chicken very dry and salt them. For extra-crisp skin leave them uncovered in the fridge for an hour.
Preheat the air fryer to 190 °C. Lay them in one layer, skin side down, in batches if needed.
Air fry 21 minutes, turning halfway, then 3 to 4 minutes at 200 °C to crisp. They are done at 75 °C inside.
Season with the pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Crispy Chicken Thighs

ingredients.name: Chicken thighs, bone-in and skin on

steps: Pat the chicken very dry and salt them. For extra-crisp skin leave them uncovered in the fridge for an hour.
Preheat the air fryer to 190 °C. Lay them in one layer, skin side down, in batches if needed.
Air fry 20 minutes, turning halfway, then 3 to 4 minutes at 200 °C to crisp. They are done at 75 °C inside.
Season with the pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Duck Legs
steps: Pat the duck very dry and salt them. For extra-crisp skin leave them uncovered in the fridge for an hour.
Preheat the air fryer to 190 °C. Lay them in one layer, skin side down, in batches if needed.
Air fry 26 minutes, turning halfway, then 3 to 4 minutes at 200 °C to crisp. They are done at 75 °C inside.
Season with the pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Pan-Seared Duck Breast
steps: Score the skin in a criss-cross without cutting the meat and salt well.
Lay skin side down in a cold pan, then put it over medium heat. Cook 10 to 12 minutes, pouring off the fat now and then, until the skin is crisp.
Turn and cook 3 minutes for pink. Rest 5 minutes and slice; keep the fat for cooking.

recipes.title: Butter-Roasted Whole Chicken
steps: Dry the chicken and salt it inside and out. Rub the butter all over.
Roast at 200 °C for 75 to 85 minutes until the juices at the thigh run clear and it reads 75 °C.
Rest 15 minutes before carving; spoon the pan juices over.

recipes.title: Spatchcock Chicken with Schmaltz
steps: Cut out the backbone with scissors and press the chicken flat. Salt it well.
Brush with the schmaltz and roast skin up at 220 °C for 45 to 50 minutes until 75 °C at the thigh.
Rest 10 minutes and cut into pieces.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Whole Chicken
steps: Salt the chicken inside and out.
Sit it breast up in the slow cooker with no liquid; it makes its own. Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours until 75 °C at the thigh.
Crisp the skin under a hot grill for 5 minutes if you like. Keep the juices for broth.

recipes.title: Turkey Thigh Roast with Butter
steps: Salt the thighs and rub with the butter.
Roast at 180 °C for 80 to 90 minutes, basting twice, until 75 °C inside.
Rest 10 minutes and slice off the bone.

recipes.title: Butter-Fried Chicken Livers
steps: Pat the livers dry and salt them.
Fry in the foaming butter over medium-high heat, 2 to 3 minutes per side, until browned and only just pink inside.
Serve with the pan butter.

recipes.title: Seared Beef Heart Steaks

ingredients.name: Beef heart, trimmed and sliced 1.5 cm thick

steps: Trim any sinew and fat from the heart and slice it. Salt well.
Sear in very hot tallow 2 to 3 minutes per side for medium-rare.
Rest 3 minutes and slice thinly across the grain.

recipes.title: Crispy Smash Patties
steps: Roll the meat into 8 loose balls.
Heat a heavy pan or griddle until smoking and add a little tallow. Put in 2 balls and press each flat with a sturdy spatula.
Salt, cook 2 minutes until deeply browned, turn, add cheese if using and cook 1 minute more.
Repeat with the rest.

recipes.title: Lamb Smash Patties
steps: Roll the meat into 8 loose balls.
Heat a heavy pan or griddle until smoking and add a little tallow. Put in 2 balls and press each flat with a sturdy spatula.
Salt, cook 2 minutes until deeply browned, turn, add cheese if using and cook 1 minute more.
Repeat with the rest.

recipes.title: Pork Smash Patties
steps: Roll the meat into 8 loose balls.
Heat a heavy pan or griddle until smoking and add a little tallow. Put in 2 balls and press each flat with a sturdy spatula.
Salt, cook 2 minutes until deeply browned, turn, add cheese if using and cook 1 minute more.
Repeat with the rest.

recipes.title: Venison Smash Patties
steps: Roll the meat into 8 loose balls.
Heat a heavy pan or griddle until smoking and add a little tallow. Put in 2 balls and press each flat with a sturdy spatula.
Salt, cook 2 minutes until deeply browned, turn, add cheese if using and cook 1 minute more.
Repeat with the rest.

recipes.title: Carnivore Meatballs
steps: Mix the beef, egg, parmesan and salt with your hands until just combined.
Roll into 20 balls.
Brown in the butter over medium heat for 10 minutes, then cover and cook 6 to 8 minutes more until cooked through.

recipes.title: Parmesan Beef Air Fryer Meatballs
steps: Mix everything and roll into 20 balls.
Air fry at 190 °C for 10 to 12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until browned and 71 °C inside.

recipes.title: Beef and Egg Meatloaf
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C. Mix everything well with your hands.
Press into a loaf tin and bake 55 to 60 minutes until 71 °C in the middle.
Pour off the fat and rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Lamb Kofta Skewers (Salt and Pepper)
steps: Knead the lamb with the salt and pepper for 2 minutes until sticky.
Shape around 8 skewers into long sausages.
Grill on high heat 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Ground Beef Chili (Meat Only)
steps: Select Sauté and brown the beef with the salt, breaking it up, for 8 minutes.
Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom clean. Lock the lid, set to Sealing and pressure cook on High for 10 minutes.
Quick release. Simmer on Sauté for 5 minutes to thicken and serve with the cheese and sour cream if you like.

recipes.title: Butter-Seared Salmon
steps: Pat the fish dry and salt it.
Sear skin side down (or presentation side down) in a hot pan with half the butter for 3 to 4 minutes until crisp.
Turn, add the rest of the butter and baste for 1 to 2 minutes until just cooked through.

recipes.title: Buttered Air Fryer Salmon
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 200 °C. Brush the fish with butter and salt it.
Air fry skin side down for 9 minutes, without turning, until it flakes.
Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Butter-Seared Cod
steps: Pat the fish dry and salt it.
Sear skin side down (or presentation side down) in a hot pan with half the butter for 3 to 4 minutes until crisp.
Turn, add the rest of the butter and baste for 1 to 2 minutes until just cooked through.

recipes.title: Buttered Air Fryer Cod
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 200 °C. Brush the fish with butter and salt it.
Air fry skin side down for 10 minutes, without turning, until it flakes.
Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Butter-Seared Trout
steps: Pat the fish dry and salt it.
Sear skin side down (or presentation side down) in a hot pan with half the butter for 3 to 4 minutes until crisp.
Turn, add the rest of the butter and baste for 1 to 2 minutes until just cooked through.

recipes.title: Buttered Air Fryer Trout
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 200 °C. Brush the fish with butter and salt it.
Air fry skin side down for 8 minutes, without turning, until it flakes.
Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Butter-Seared Mackerel
steps: Pat the fish dry and salt it.
Sear skin side down (or presentation side down) in a hot pan with half the butter for 3 to 4 minutes until crisp.
Turn, add the rest of the butter and baste for 1 to 2 minutes until just cooked through.

recipes.title: Buttered Air Fryer Mackerel
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 200 °C. Brush the fish with butter and salt it.
Air fry skin side down for 7 minutes, without turning, until it flakes.
Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Butter-Seared Halibut
steps: Pat the fish dry and salt it.
Sear skin side down (or presentation side down) in a hot pan with half the butter for 3 to 4 minutes until crisp.
Turn, add the rest of the butter and baste for 1 to 2 minutes until just cooked through.

recipes.title: Buttered Air Fryer Halibut
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 200 °C. Brush the fish with butter and salt it.
Air fry skin side down for 10 minutes, without turning, until it flakes.
Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Butter-Seared Sea Bass
steps: Pat the fish dry and salt it.
Sear skin side down (or presentation side down) in a hot pan with half the butter for 3 to 4 minutes until crisp.
Turn, add the rest of the butter and baste for 1 to 2 minutes until just cooked through.

recipes.title: Buttered Air Fryer Sea Bass
steps: Preheat the air fryer to 200 °C. Brush the fish with butter and salt it.
Air fry skin side down for 7 minutes, without turning, until it flakes.
Serve straight away.

recipes.title: Broiled Tuna Steaks
steps: Brush the tuna with ghee and salt it.
Cook under a very hot grill or broiler 2 to 3 minutes per side for pink in the middle.
Slice and serve.

recipes.title: Steamed Mussels in Bone Broth
steps: Throw away any mussels that are cracked or stay open when tapped.
Bring the broth and butter to a boil, add the mussels, cover and cook 4 to 5 minutes, shaking the pan, until they open.
Throw away any that stay shut.

recipes.title: Crab and Egg Scramble
steps: Beat the eggs with the salt.
Melt the butter over low heat, add the eggs and stir slowly.
When almost set, fold in the crab and warm through.

recipes.title: Sardines on Fried Eggs
steps: Fry the eggs in the butter until the whites set.
Warm the sardines in the same pan for a minute.
Serve the sardines on the eggs with the salt.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Egg Bites
steps: Heat the oven to 160 °C and butter a 12-hole mini muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs, cream and salt, stir in the salmon and pour into the holes.
Bake 12 minutes until just set. Cool a little before turning out.

recipes.title: Three-Egg Butter Omelette with Cheese
steps: Beat the eggs with the salt.
Melt the butter in a nonstick pan over medium heat, pour in the eggs and stir with a fork until softly set.
Scatter over the cheese, fold and slide onto a plate.

recipes.title: Slow Soft Scrambled Eggs with Cream
steps: Put the eggs and butter in a cold pan over low heat.
Stir constantly with a spatula for 6 to 8 minutes, taking the pan off the heat now and then, until creamy.
Stir in the cream and salt.

recipes.title: Cheese and Egg Waffles (Chaffles)
steps: Heat a waffle iron. Mix the eggs, mozzarella and salt.
Spoon half into the iron and cook 4 to 5 minutes until golden and crisp.
Repeat with the rest.

recipes.title: Baked Parmesan Crisps
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C and line a tray with baking paper.
Make 12 small piles of the cheese, spaced apart, and flatten them.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes until golden. Cool on the tray to crisp.

recipes.title: Air Fryer Cheese Crisps
steps: Line the air fryer basket with a round of baking paper.
Make 8 small piles of cheese, spaced apart.
Air fry at 180 °C for 5 to 6 minutes until golden; cool to crisp.

recipes.title: Baked Egg Custard (No Sugar)
steps: Heat the oven to 150 °C. Whisk the eggs, cream and salt.
Pour into 4 ramekins and set them in a roasting tin. Pour hot water halfway up the sides.
Bake 35 to 40 minutes until set with a slight wobble. Chill.

recipes.title: Bacon-Free Pork Belly Breakfast Plate
steps: Lay the pork belly in a cold pan, salt it and cook over medium heat for 20 to 25 minutes, turning, until crisp.
Fry the eggs in the rendered fat.
Serve together.

recipes.title: Chicken Skin Cracklings
steps: Lay the skin flat on a lined tray, pressing it out.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 to 25 minutes, with a second tray on top for flat crisps, until golden.
Drain on paper and salt while hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Bone Broth (Stovetop)
steps: Put the wings (or carcasses saved from roast chickens) in a big pot with the water and bring slowly to a simmer, skimming the foam.
Simmer very gently, uncovered, for 5 to 6 hours, topping up with water to keep the bones covered.
Strain, season and chill. Lift off the fat to cook with.

recipes.title: Beef Broth Sipping Cup
steps: Heat the broth until steaming.
Season with salt and stir in the butter. Drink from a mug.

recipes.title: Lamb Neck Braise in Bone Broth
steps: Salt the lamb and brown it all over in the ghee.
Add the broth, cover and cook at 150 °C for 2½ hours until tender.
Reduce the juices on the hob and spoon over.

recipes.title: Venison Medallions in Butter
steps: Salt the venison.
Sear in a hot pan 2 to 3 minutes per side, adding the butter for the last minute, for rare to medium-rare; venison is very lean so don't overcook.
Rest 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Roast Bone Marrow
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C. Stand the bones cut side up on a tray.
Roast 15 to 20 minutes until the marrow is soft and just starting to bubble.
Scoop out and sprinkle with flaky salt.

recipes.title: Prime Rib Roast
steps: Salt the roast all over the day before and leave uncovered in the fridge.
Roast at 110 °C for 2 to 2½ hours until 50 °C in the centre.
Rest 30 minutes, then blast at 260 °C for 8 to 10 minutes to brown the crust. Carve and season with pepper.

recipes.title: Slow-Roasted Leg of Lamb
steps: Salt the lamb well. Put it in a roasting tin with the water and cover tightly with foil.
Roast at 150 °C for 4 hours until it pulls apart.
Uncover for the last 20 minutes at 200 °C to brown.

recipes.title: Carnitas-Style Crispy Pork (Lard Only)

ingredients.name: Pork shoulder, cut into 5 cm chunks

steps: Put the pork, salt, lard and water in a heavy pot.
Simmer gently, partly covered, for 2½ hours until tender and the water has gone.
Keep cooking in the fat, turning, for 15 minutes until browned and crisp at the edges.

recipes.title: Pork Rind Crumbed Chicken Tenders
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Beat the eggs with the salt.
Dip the chicken in egg, then press into the pork rind crumbs.
Bake on a rack 15 minutes, turning once, until golden and 75 °C inside.

recipes.title: Tiramisu-Style Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and chia seeds together in a bowl or two jars.
Stir in the flavourings, keeping any nuts or crunchy toppings back.
Cover and chill overnight, or at least 4 hours. Stir, loosen with a splash of milk and add the toppings.

recipes.title: Cherry Vanilla Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and chia seeds together in a bowl or two jars.
Stir in the flavourings, keeping any nuts or crunchy toppings back.
Cover and chill overnight, or at least 4 hours. Stir, loosen with a splash of milk and add the toppings.

recipes.title: Pineapple Coconut Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and chia seeds together in a bowl or two jars.
Stir in the flavourings, keeping any nuts or crunchy toppings back.
Cover and chill overnight, or at least 4 hours. Stir, loosen with a splash of milk and add the toppings.

recipes.title: Fig and Honey Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and chia seeds together in a bowl or two jars.
Stir in the flavourings, keeping any nuts or crunchy toppings back.
Cover and chill overnight, or at least 4 hours. Stir, loosen with a splash of milk and add the toppings.

recipes.title: Vanilla Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk the chia seeds with the milk and any cocoa, nut butter, sweetener or flavouring until no clumps remain.
Leave 10 minutes, whisk again, then cover and chill at least 3 hours or overnight.
Spoon into bowls and top with the fruit.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk the chia seeds with the milk and any cocoa, nut butter, sweetener or flavouring until no clumps remain.
Leave 10 minutes, whisk again, then cover and chill at least 3 hours or overnight.
Spoon into bowls and top with the fruit.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Thyme Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Beat the eggs with the salt.
Heat the oil in an ovenproof frying pan and cook the vegetables (and chorizo, if using) for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Pour in the eggs, scatter over any cheese or herbs and cook on the hob 3 minutes until the edges set.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until just set in the middle. Rest 5 minutes and cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Pepper and Chorizo Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Beat the eggs with the salt.
Heat the oil in an ovenproof frying pan and cook the vegetables (and chorizo, if using) for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Pour in the eggs, scatter over any cheese or herbs and cook on the hob 3 minutes until the edges set.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until just set in the middle. Rest 5 minutes and cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Zucchini and Herb Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Beat the eggs with the salt.
Heat the oil in an ovenproof frying pan and cook the vegetables (and chorizo, if using) for 6 to 8 minutes until soft.
Pour in the eggs, scatter over any cheese or herbs and cook on the hob 3 minutes until the edges set.
Bake 10 to 12 minutes until just set in the middle. Rest 5 minutes and cut into wedges.

recipes.title: Egg Muffin Cups with Spinach
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and oil a 12-hole muffin tin well.
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt. Divide the fillings between the holes and pour over the egg.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until puffed and set. Cool 5 minutes before lifting out. They keep 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Egg Muffin Cups with Peppers
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and oil a 12-hole muffin tin well.
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt. Divide the fillings between the holes and pour over the egg.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until puffed and set. Cool 5 minutes before lifting out. They keep 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Ham and Cheese Egg Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and oil a 12-hole muffin tin well.
Whisk the eggs, milk and salt. Divide the fillings between the holes and pour over the egg.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes until puffed and set. Cool 5 minutes before lifting out. They keep 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Turkish Eggs (Çılbır)
steps: Stir the garlic into the yogurt with a pinch of salt and spread on two plates.
Poach the eggs in gently simmering water for 3 minutes.
Melt the butter with the chili flakes until sizzling.
Put the eggs on the yogurt, spoon over the chili butter and scatter with dill.

recipes.title: Corned Beef Hash with Eggs
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and corned beef, press down and cook 8 to 10 minutes, turning now and then, until crusty.
Fry the eggs and serve on top.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Spinach Breakfast Skillet
steps: Fry the mushrooms in the oil over high heat until browned.
Add the garlic and spinach and stir until wilted. Season.
Make hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 4 minutes. Serve with toast.

recipes.title: Ricotta Honey Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread the ricotta on the toast, drizzle with honey and scatter the walnuts.

recipes.title: Smashed Pea and Feta Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Cook the peas 3 minutes, drain and crush with lemon juice and salt. Pile on the toast and crumble over the feta.

recipes.title: Tomato Toast with Olive Oil
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Rub the hot toast with the cut garlic. Grate the tomatoes, season with salt and spoon on. Drizzle with oil.

recipes.title: Strawberry Cottage Cheese Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread the cottage cheese on the toast and top with the strawberries and honey.

recipes.title: Hummus and Egg Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread the hummus on the toast. Slice the eggs on top and dust with paprika.

recipes.title: Beans on Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Heat the beans until bubbling. Butter the toast, spoon over the beans and top with cheese.

recipes.title: Buckwheat Crepes with Egg and Cheese
steps: Whisk the flour, 1 of the eggs, the water and a pinch of salt into a thin batter and rest 30 minutes.
Cook a thin crepe in a buttered pan for 1 minute, flip.
Crack one of the remaining eggs in the middle, scatter with cheese and cook until the white sets, then fold the edges in. Repeat.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Waffles
steps: Whisk the sweet potato, eggs, milk and butter.
Stir in the flour, baking powder, cinnamon and a pinch of salt.
Cook in a hot greased waffle iron for 4 to 5 minutes until crisp.

recipes.title: Polenta Breakfast Bowl
steps: Bring the milk to a simmer and whisk in the polenta. Cook 5 minutes, whisking, until thick.
Stir in the parmesan and butter.
Top with fried or poached eggs.

recipes.title: Banana Oat Breakfast Cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C and line a tray.
Mash the bananas and mix in everything else.
Drop 12 spoonfuls on the tray and flatten. Bake 14 to 15 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Yogurt Parfait with Granola and Berries
steps: Layer the yogurt, berries and granola in two glasses.
Drizzle with honey and eat straight away so the granola stays crunchy.

recipes.title: Acai-Style Berry Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend the berries, banana and juice until thick and smooth, adding juice a little at a time.
Spoon into bowls and top with granola and coconut.

recipes.title: Green Smoothie Bowl
steps: Blend the spinach, bananas, mango and milk until thick.
Spoon into bowls and scatter with seeds.

recipes.title: Congee with Ginger and Spring Onion
steps: Rinse the rice and put in a pot with the water and half the ginger.
Simmer gently, partly covered, for 50 to 60 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and silky.
Season with salt and top with spring onions, the rest of the ginger, soy sauce and sesame oil.

recipes.title: Japanese Rolled Omelette (Tamagoyaki)
steps: Beat the eggs with the sugar, soy sauce and mirin.
Oil a small pan over medium-low heat. Pour in a thin layer, let it just set and roll it to one side.
Add another thin layer, lifting the roll so egg runs underneath, then roll back. Repeat.
Rest 2 minutes and slice.

recipes.title: Simit-Style Breakfast Plate
steps: Peel and halve the eggs.
Arrange everything on a plate with the bread and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Arepas with Cheese
steps: Mix the flour, water and salt into a soft dough and rest 5 minutes.
Shape into 6 patties about 1.5 cm thick.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan over medium heat 6 to 7 minutes per side until crusty.
Split and fill with the cheese while hot.

recipes.title: Gallo Pinto with Eggs

ingredients.name: Black beans, cooked, with a little liquid

steps: Fry the onion and pepper in a little oil until soft.
Add the beans with some liquid and the sauce and simmer 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice until hot and well coloured.
Fry the eggs and serve on top.

recipes.title: Swedish Rye Crispbread Breakfast
steps: Butter the crispbreads.
Top with cheese, cucumber and sliced egg.

recipes.title: Shakshuka with Feta and Spinach
steps: Soften the onion and peppers in a little oil 8 minutes, add garlic and cumin.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes, then wilt in the spinach.
Make hollows, crack in the eggs, crumble over feta, cover and cook 6 minutes.

recipes.title: Croque Madame Bake
steps: Layer bread, mustard, ham and cheese in a dish.
Whisk 4 eggs with the milk and pour over; soak 10 minutes.
Bake at 180 °C for 25 minutes, then crack 2 eggs on top and bake 6 minutes more.

recipes.title: Baked French Toast Casserole
steps: Put the bread and blueberries in a buttered dish.
Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar, cinnamon and vanilla and pour over; soak 30 minutes or overnight.
Bake at 180 °C for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Egg Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 180 °C.
Whisk everything with salt and pour into a greased dish.
Bake 30 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Baked Oatmeal
steps: Mash 1 banana with the peanut butter, milk, eggs and honey.
Stir in the oats and baking powder, pour into a dish and top with the other banana, sliced.
Bake at 180 °C for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Savory Dutch Baby with Ham and Gruyère
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C with the butter in a cast-iron pan.
Blend the eggs, milk, flour and salt.
Pour into the hot pan, scatter ham and cheese and bake 18 to 20 minutes until puffed.

recipes.title: Moroccan Msemen-Style Flatbreads
steps: Knead the flour, semolina, salt and water and rest 20 minutes.
Divide, flatten thin with oiled hands, brush with butter and fold into squares.
Cook on a hot pan 3 minutes per side. Serve with honey.

steps: Rinse the poha and drain.
Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and peanuts in oil, add the onion and potato and cook 6 minutes.
Add the turmeric, poha and salt and toss 2 minutes. Finish with lemon.

recipes.title: South Indian Upma
steps: Toast the semolina until fragrant.
Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves, chili, ginger and onion in the ghee.
Add the water and salt, bring to a boil and stir in the semolina until thick.

recipes.title: Japanese Tamago Sando

recipes.title: Strawberry Lassi

recipes.title: Ayran

steps: Stir the maple syrup into the coffee.
Fill a glass with ice, add the oat milk and pour over the coffee.

recipes.title: Turmeric Ginger Tea
steps: Simmer the turmeric and ginger in the water for 10 minutes.
Strain and stir in the honey and lemon.

steps: Soak the oats and cinnamon in the water for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Coffee Milkshake

recipes.title: Date and Almond Milkshake

recipes.title: Avocado Shake

recipes.title: Tamarind Agua Fresca
steps: Simmer the tamarind in 500 ml of the water for 5 minutes and mash.
Strain, add the sugar and the rest of the water.

recipes.title: Mint Lemonade (Limonana)

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Pie Smoothie

recipes.title: Papaya Lime Smoothie

recipes.title: Agua de Pepino con Limón y Chía
steps: Blend the cucumbers with the lime juice, sugar and half the water and strain.

recipes.title: Korean Sikhye-Style Rice Drink
steps: Simmer the rice, ginger and water 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Brazilian Lemonade (Limonada Suíça)
steps: Blend the limes, sugar and water for only 10 seconds.

recipes.title: Spiced Pear and Ginger Apple Cider

recipes.title: Coconut Water Pineapple Cooler
steps: Blend the pineapple with half the coconut water and strain.

steps: Put the onions, butter and sugar in the slow cooker. Cover and cook on High for 8 hours, stirring once or twice, until deep golden.
Add the stock and thyme and cook on High for 1 to 2 hours more.
Ladle into bowls, top with the bread and cheese and grill until bubbling.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Steel-Cut Oats
steps: Grease the slow cooker well and add everything with a pinch of salt.
Cover and cook on Low for 7 hours, overnight.
Stir well and loosen with a little milk.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Pinto Beans
steps: Put the beans, onion, garlic, cumin and water in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 8 hours until creamy.
Season with salt only at the end and discard the onion.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Mushroom Stroganoff
steps: Put the mushrooms, onion, garlic, paprika and stock in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 4 hours.
Stir in the sour cream and parsley and season. Serve over noodles or rice.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Turkey Chili
steps: Brown the turkey in a pan and tip into the slow cooker.
Add everything else with 1 tsp salt.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Applesauce
steps: Put everything in the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 4 hours until very soft.
Mash or blend.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Baked Potatoes
steps: Prick the potatoes, rub with oil and salt and wrap each in foil.
Cook on Low for 7 to 8 hours until soft.
Split and fill with butter and cheese.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Tinga
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Soften the onion in a little oil for 4 minutes.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the chicken, tomatoes, chipotle and oregano.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick release the rest and open the lid carefully.
Shred the chicken and simmer on Sauté for 5 minutes to thicken. Serve in tortillas.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Dal Makhani

ingredients.name: Brown lentils (or whole urad), soaked overnight

steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Melt the butter and fry the onion and ginger garlic paste for 4 minutes.

Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the drained lentils, beans, passata and garam masala.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 30 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Stir in the cream, mash a little and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Steel-Cut Oatmeal
steps: Pour in the water and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add the oats, butter, cinnamon and a pinch of salt.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 10 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Stir in the milk and add your toppings.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Beef Pho-Style Broth
steps: Put the bones, brisket, onion, ginger and spices in the pot with the water up to the max line.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 60 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Strain, slice the brisket and season the broth with fish sauce. Serve over rice noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Vegetable Minestrone
steps: Select Sauté and heat the pot. Soften the onion, carrot and celery.

Pour in the stock and scrape the bottom of the inner pot clean, so nothing is stuck and the pot doesn't show a burn warning. An electric pressure cooker needs at least 1 cup (250 ml) of thin liquid to come up to pressure.
Add everything else.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 4 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Quick release the pressure by turning the valve to Venting, keeping your hands and face away from the steam, then open the lid when the float valve drops.
Season and serve with parmesan.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Cheesecake
steps: Press the biscuit and butter into a 18 cm springform tin. Beat the cream cheese, sugar, eggs and vanilla smooth and pour over. Cover with foil and set on the trivet with the water in the pot.
Lock the lid and turn the valve to Sealing. Pressure cook on High for 35 minutes. The pot first takes about 10 to 15 minutes to come up to pressure; that is not part of the cook time.
Let the pressure release naturally for about 15 minutes, until the float valve drops, then open the lid.
Chill at least 4 hours before slicing.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Congee

recipes.title: Instant Pot Chicken Soup with Rice

Shred the chicken off the bones and stir back in.

recipes.title: Instant Pot Cannellini Beans with Rosemary

steps: Season and fry the chicken in the oil 5 to 6 minutes per side until 75 °C; rest.
Fry the garlic for 30 seconds, add the stock, lemon juice and butter and bubble 2 minutes.
Wilt the spinach in the sauce and spoon over the chicken.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Shrimp
steps: Sear the shrimp in the oil 1 minute per side and lift out.
Fry the garlic and tomatoes, add the cream and parmesan and simmer 3 minutes.
Add the spinach and shrimp and warm through.

recipes.title: Gnocchi with Sausage and Peppers
steps: Fry the sausage meat, breaking it up, until browned.
Add the peppers and onion and cook 6 minutes.
Stir in the passata. Boil the gnocchi until they float and toss them in.

recipes.title: Pesto Chicken Pasta with Tomatoes
steps: Cook the pasta.
Fry the chicken in the oil 7 to 8 minutes until cooked.
Add the tomatoes for 2 minutes, then the drained pasta, pesto and a splash of pasta water. Top with parmesan.

recipes.title: Chorizo and Chickpea Skillet
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil until it releases its oil.
Add the chickpeas, tomatoes and paprika and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.

recipes.title: Quick Beef Bulgogi Bowls
steps: Start the rice. Mix the beef with the soy, sugar, sesame oil, garlic and pear for 10 minutes.
Cook in a very hot pan in batches, 2 minutes each.
Serve over rice with spring onions.

recipes.title: Salmon with Lemon Dill Yogurt
steps: Boil the potatoes 15 minutes.
Fry the salmon skin side down in the oil 4 minutes, turn and cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Mix the yogurt with dill, lemon zest and juice and salt and serve with the fish and potatoes.

recipes.title: Pork Chops with Apples and Onions
steps: Season and fry the chops in the oil 4 minutes per side until 63 °C; rest.
Fry the apples and onion 5 minutes.
Add the juice and mustard, bubble 2 minutes and spoon over the chops.

recipes.title: Thai Red Curry Noodles
steps: Soak the noodles in boiling water as the pack says.
Fry the paste in a splash of coconut milk, add the chicken and cook 4 minutes.
Add the rest of the milk, pepper and fish sauce and simmer 5 minutes. Toss with noodles and lime.

recipes.title: Spicy Sausage Orzo
steps: Brown the sausage with the onion.
Add the orzo, tomatoes, stock and chili, cover and simmer 12 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in the spinach.

recipes.title: Egg Fried Noodles with Greens
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Scramble the eggs in the oil, add garlic and bok choy and stir-fry 2 minutes.
Toss in the noodles and sauces.

recipes.title: Cajun Shrimp and Sausage Skillet
steps: Fry the sausage in the oil 3 minutes.
Add the onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Add the shrimp and seasoning and cook 3 minutes until pink.

recipes.title: Tortellini with Brown Butter and Peas
steps: Cook the tortellini, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Brown the butter until nutty.
Toss with the drained pasta, lemon zest and parmesan.

recipes.title: Moroccan-Spiced Lamb Pitas
steps: Fry the lamb with the spice and a pinch of salt until browned, 8 minutes.
Mix the yogurt, cucumber and mint.
Fill warm pitas with lamb and yogurt.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowls
steps: Start the rice. Fry the salmon 4 minutes skin side down and 2 minutes on the other side.
Pour in the teriyaki and bubble until glossy.
Serve over rice with cucumber, avocado and sesame.

recipes.title: Mushroom Stroganoff with Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles.
Fry the onion and mushrooms in the butter 8 minutes until golden.
Stir in the paprika and sour cream with a splash of water and toss with the noodles.

recipes.title: Steak Tacos with Lime Onions
steps: Toss the onion with the juice of 1 lime and a pinch of salt.
Season the steak with cumin and salt and sear 3 minutes per side; rest and slice.
Fill warm tortillas with steak, onions and coriander.

recipes.title: Thai Yellow Sweet Potato and Spinach Coconut Curry
steps: Heat the oil and fry any seeds, leaves or curry paste for 1 minute, then add the onion and cook 6 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and spices and cook 1 minute.
Add the firmer vegetables (and lentils), the coconut milk and stock with 1 tsp salt. Simmer 15 to 20 minutes until tender.
Add the leafy greens, peas or beans for the last 5 minutes. Finish with lime if using and serve with rice.

steps: Roast the chickpeas with the oil, spice and salt at 210 °C for 25 minutes.
Cook the bulgur.
Thin the tahini with lemon and water.
Build bowls with bulgur, chopped salad, chickpeas and tahini.

recipes.title: Miso Glazed Tofu Rice Bowls
steps: Start the rice. Mix the miso, maple and vinegar.
Fry the tofu until golden, brush with the glaze and cook 1 minute more per side.
Serve over rice with cucumber and edamame.

recipes.title: Black Bean Burrito Bowls
steps: Cook the rice and stir in lime juice.
Warm the beans with cumin and salt.
Build bowls with rice, beans, corn, avocado and salsa.

recipes.title: Lentil Tabbouleh Bowls
steps: Simmer the lentils 20 to 25 minutes until just tender; drain.
Chop the herbs, tomatoes and cucumber finely.
Toss everything with lemon juice, oil and salt.

recipes.title: Sesame Soba Noodle Bowls
steps: Cook the soba, rinse in cold water.
Whisk the tahini, soy, vinegar and maple with 2 tbsp water.
Toss the noodles with the sauce and vegetables.

recipes.title: Harissa Roasted Vegetable Couscous
steps: Roast the chopped vegetables and chickpeas with the harissa and oil at 210 °C for 25 minutes.
Pour 300 ml boiling water over the couscous, cover 5 minutes and fluff.
Toss together.

recipes.title: Peanut Tempeh Noodle Bowls
steps: Fry the tempeh until golden.
Soak the noodles.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy, lime and maple with warm water.
Toss everything together.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Quinoa Bowls with Feta
steps: Cook the quinoa and cool slightly.
Chop the vegetables.
Toss with olives, lemon, oil and salt and crumble over the feta.

recipes.title: Chickpea and Sweet Potato Patties
steps: Mash the chickpeas and sweet potato flesh with the spice, coriander and salt.
Mix in the breadcrumbs and shape 8 patties.
Fry in the oil 3 to 4 minutes per side until crisp.

recipes.title: Lentil Walnut Burgers
steps: Pulse the walnuts and oats fine, then add the lentils, onion, soy and paprika and pulse to a rough mix.
Shape 4 patties and chill 15 minutes.
Fry 4 minutes per side and serve in buns.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Lentil Shepherd's Pie (Vegan)
steps: Boil and mash the potatoes with 2 tbsp oil and salt.
Fry the onion, carrot and mushrooms in the rest of the oil 10 minutes, add the paste, lentils and stock and simmer 10 minutes.
Top with mash and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Lasagna with Zucchini and Spinach
steps: Layer sauce, sheets, zucchini, spinach and ricotta three times.
Finish with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover and bake at 190 °C for 30 minutes, uncover for 15.

recipes.title: White Bean and Kale Stew
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the tomatoes, beans, stock and rosemary and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the kale for 5 minutes and mash a few beans to thicken.

recipes.title: Tofu Tikka Masala
steps: Toss the tofu with the yogurt and half the paste and grill until charred.
Fry the onion in the oil with the rest of the paste.
Add the passata and cream, simmer 10 minutes and add the tofu.

recipes.title: Cauliflower Steaks with Chimichurri
steps: Brush the cauliflower with 1 tbsp oil and salt and roast at 220 °C for 25 minutes, turning once.
Chop the parsley and garlic and mix with the vinegar, chili and the rest of the oil.
Spoon over the steaks.

recipes.title: Eggplant and Tomato Bake with Feta
steps: Brush the eggplant with oil and roast at 220 °C for 20 minutes.
Simmer the tomatoes, garlic and oregano 10 minutes.
Layer in a dish, crumble over feta and bake 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Vegan Mushroom Bourguignon
steps: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Fry the onions and carrots 5 minutes, stir in the flour and paste.
Add the stock, soy, thyme and mushrooms and simmer 30 minutes until thick.

recipes.title: Spiced Lentil and Spinach Soup (Vegan)
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, add the curry powder.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir in the spinach.

recipes.title: Butternut Squash Mac and Cheese
steps: Simmer the squash in the milk 15 minutes until soft and blend smooth.
Cook the macaroni.
Stir the cheese, mustard and butter into the squash sauce and toss with the pasta.

recipes.title: Vegan Black Bean Chili with Sweet Potato
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil, stir in the spices.
Add the sweet potato, beans and tomatoes with 250 ml water and simmer 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Paneer Bhurji Wraps
steps: Fry the onion and chili in the oil 5 minutes, add the tomatoes and spices for 3 minutes.
Stir in the paneer and cook 3 minutes.
Wrap in warm flatbreads.

recipes.title: Vegetable Korma with Cashews
steps: Blend the cashews with the coconut milk.
Fry the onion in the oil with the paste.
Add the vegetables and cashew milk and simmer 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Spanakorizo (Spinach Rice)
steps: Soften the onions in the oil.
Add the rice and 500 ml water and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the spinach and dill, cover and cook 8 minutes. Finish with lemon.

recipes.title: Mujadara (Lentils and Rice with Crispy Onions)
steps: Fry the onions in the oil over medium heat 25 minutes until deep brown.
Simmer the lentils 15 minutes, add the rice, cumin and half the onions with 500 ml water and cook 15 minutes.
Top with the rest of the onions.

recipes.title: Carrot Spice Muffins (by Weight)
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (180 °C fan) and line a 12-hole muffin tin. Set a bowl on the scale and weigh as you go.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar (and any ground almonds, oats or spice).
Weigh the milk and oil into a jug, then beat in the eggs. Pour onto the dry mix with the fruit, veg, nuts or chips and fold just until no dry flour shows.
Divide between the cases (about 75 g each) and bake 20 to 22 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.
