steps: Mix everything into a firm dough and rest 30 minutes.
Roll very thin between baking paper, score into squares and prick.
Bake at 180 °C for 20 to 25 minutes until crisp.

recipes.title: Same-Day Crusty White Loaf
steps: Mix to a shaggy dough, rest 20 minutes, then knead 8 minutes.
Rise 1½ hours until doubled. Shape into a round and rise 45 minutes on a floured tray.
Slash and bake at 230 °C for 30 to 35 minutes, until it sounds hollow underneath.

recipes.title: Overnight No-Knead Bread
steps: Stir everything into a wet dough, cover and leave 12 to 18 hours at room temperature.
Fold into a ball on a floured counter and rest 1 hour.
Bake in a preheated lidded pot at 240 °C for 30 minutes, then 15 uncovered.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Sandwich Bread
steps: Mix and knead 10 minutes until smooth.
Rise 1 hour, shape into a 900 g loaf tin and rise 45 minutes.
Bake at 200 °C for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Rosemary Focaccia (by Weight)
steps: Mix the flour, water, yeast and salt into a sticky dough. Fold it over itself 4 times, 15 minutes apart.
Rise 1 hour, then tip into an oiled tin, dimple with oily fingers and rise 45 minutes.
Top with rosemary and a pinch more salt and bake at 220 °C for 22 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Milk Bread Rolls (Tangzhong)
steps: Cook 25 g of the flour with 125 g of the milk, whisking, until a thick paste; cool.
Knead it with everything else for 10 minutes until smooth.
Rise 1 hour, divide into 12 balls (about 55 g each), rise 40 minutes and bake at 180 °C for 18 to 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies (by Weight)
steps: Brown the butter until nutty, then cool 10 minutes.
Whisk in the sugars, egg and vanilla, then the flour, soda and salt, then the chocolate.
Scoop 50 g balls and chill 30 minutes. Bake at 180 °C for 10 to 11 minutes.

recipes.title: Oat and Raisin Cookies (by Weight)
steps: Beat the butter and sugar, then the egg.
Mix in everything else.
Scoop 40 g balls onto lined trays and bake at 180 °C for 12 to 13 minutes.

recipes.title: Almond Flour Shortbread
steps: Rub everything together into a dough.
Press into a 20 cm tin and prick.
Bake at 160 °C for 25 minutes; cut while warm.

recipes.title: Lemon Drizzle Loaf (by Weight)
steps: Beat the butter and sugar, then the eggs one by one, then fold in the flour and lemon zest.
Bake in a lined 900 g loaf tin at 180 °C for 40 to 45 minutes.
Mix the lemon juice with the powdered sugar and pour over the hot cake.

recipes.title: Chocolate Olive Oil Cake
steps: Whisk the dry ingredients.
Whisk in the oil, hot water, vanilla and vinegar until smooth.
Bake in a lined 20 cm tin at 180 °C for 30 to 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Sugar Scones (by Weight)
steps: Rub the butter into the flour, sugar and cinnamon.
Mix in the milk to a soft dough.
Pat 3 cm thick, cut 8 rounds, brush with egg and bake at 220 °C for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Cheese and Chive Scones
steps: Rub the butter into the flour with a pinch of salt.
Stir in most of the cheese, the chives and milk.
Pat 3 cm thick, cut 8 rounds, brush with egg, top with the rest of the cheese and bake at 220 °C for 12 to 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Soft Pretzels (by Weight)
steps: Knead the flour, water, yeast, salt and butter 8 minutes and rise 1 hour.
Divide into 8 (about 105 g), roll into ropes and twist.
Dip each in 2 litres simmering water with the soda for 30 seconds.
Brush with egg, sprinkle with a little extra salt and bake at 220 °C for 12 to 14 minutes.

recipes.title: Pizza Dough (by Weight)
steps: Mix and knead 8 minutes until smooth.
Rise 2 hours (or overnight in the fridge).
Divide into 4 balls of about 210 g, rest 30 minutes, stretch thin and bake at the hottest oven setting for 8 to 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Brioche Burger Buns
steps: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, 3 of the eggs and the milk 8 minutes, then knead in the butter.
Rise 1½ hours, divide into 8 balls (about 110 g) and rise 1 hour.
Brush with the last egg, beaten, and bake at 190 °C for 15 to 18 minutes.

recipes.title: Flapjacks (by Weight)
steps: Melt the butter, sugar and syrup.
Stir in the oats and salt and press into a lined 20 cm tin.
Bake at 180 °C for 20 to 25 minutes; cut while warm.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Kelewele (Spiced Plantains)
steps: Toss the plantain with the ginger, onion, spices and salt and leave 15 minutes.
Fry in hot oil in batches 3 to 4 minutes until deep golden.

recipes.title: Peruvian Papa a la Huancaína

ingredients.name: Green chilies (aji amarillo if you can find them)

steps: Boil and slice the potatoes.
Blend the cheese, chilies, milk and crackers until smooth and thick.
Pour over the potatoes and top with egg and olives.

recipes.title: Nepali Momo with Tomato Achar
steps: Mix the chicken, onion, ginger, garlic, coriander and salt.
Fill and pleat the wrappers.
Steam 12 to 15 minutes.
Char the tomatoes and chili, blend with toasted sesame and salt for the achar.

recipes.title: Nepali Aloo Tama-Style Potato Stew
steps: Fry the onion with the spices in the oil.
Add the tomatoes, potatoes, bamboo shoots, peas and 800 ml water.
Simmer 25 minutes until the potatoes are soft.

recipes.title: Norwegian Fiskesuppe (Creamy Fish Soup)
steps: Simmer the sliced carrot and leek in the stock 10 minutes.
Add the cream and fish and poach 5 minutes.
Season and stir in the dill.

recipes.title: Norwegian Fårikål (Lamb and Cabbage)
steps: Layer the lamb and cabbage in a pot, sprinkling each layer with flour, salt and peppercorns.
Add the water, cover and simmer gently 2½ hours.
Serve with boiled potatoes.

recipes.title: Danish Frikadeller
steps: Mix the pork, onion, egg, flour, milk and salt to a soft mix and rest 15 minutes.
Shape oval patties with a wet spoon.
Fry in the butter 5 to 6 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Danish Rye Bread Open Sandwiches with Egg
steps: Butter the bread.
Top with sliced egg, shrimp and a little mayonnaise.
Finish with dill.

recipes.title: Finnish Lohikeitto (Salmon Soup)
steps: Soften the leek in the butter.
Add the potatoes and stock and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the cream and salmon and poach 5 minutes, then stir in the dill.

recipes.title: Egyptian Molokhia-Style Green Soup
steps: Bring the stock to a simmer and stir in the molokhia; cook 5 minutes without boiling hard.
Fry the garlic and coriander in the ghee until golden and stir in.
Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Australian Lamingtons
steps: Make a sponge from the butter, sugar, eggs and flour and bake in a 20 cm square tin at 180 °C for 25 minutes; cool.
Cut into 16 squares.
Mix the powdered sugar, cocoa and warm milk into an icing.
Dip each square in icing, then roll in coconut.

recipes.title: Australian Anzac Biscuits
steps: Mix the oats, flour, coconut and sugar.
Melt the butter and syrup, stir in the soda with 2 tbsp boiling water and mix into the dry ingredients.
Roll into balls, flatten and bake at 160 °C for 12 minutes.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Varenyky with Potato
steps: Knead the flour, egg, water and salt into a dough and rest 30 minutes.
Boil and mash the potatoes with half the onion fried in butter.
Roll thin, cut rounds, fill and seal.
Boil until they float plus 2 minutes and serve with the rest of the fried onion and sour cream.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Syrniki (Cottage Cheese Pancakes)
steps: Mix the cheese, eggs, sugar, vanilla and most of the flour.
Shape into 12 patties and dust with the rest of the flour.
Fry in the oil over medium heat 3 minutes per side. Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Singaporean Hainanese Chicken Rice
steps: Poach the chicken with ginger and spring onions in barely simmering water 40 minutes, then plunge into iced water.
Fry the garlic and rice in a little chicken fat or oil and cook in 600 ml of the broth.
Rub the chicken with sesame oil, chop and serve with rice, cucumber and soy.

recipes.title: Singaporean Chili Crab-Style Shrimp
steps: Fry the garlic and ginger in the oil.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes.
Add the sauces and 100 ml water and simmer 3 minutes, then stir in the egg in ribbons.

recipes.title: Uzbek Achichuk Tomato Salad
steps: Salt the onion and rinse after 5 minutes.
Layer with the tomatoes, herbs and chili and season with salt.

recipes.title: Ecuadorian Locro de Papa
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and spices.
Add the potatoes and 1 litre water and simmer 25 minutes, mashing some.
Stir in the milk and half the cheese. Top with avocado and the rest of the cheese.

recipes.title: Chilean Pastel de Choclo
steps: Fry the beef and onions with the spices.
Blend the corn, milk and basil and cook until thick.
Put the beef in a dish with egg and olives, spread the corn on top, sprinkle sugar and bake at 200 °C for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Chilean Pebre
steps: Mix everything with salt.
Leave 15 minutes before serving with bread or grilled meat.

recipes.title: Guatemalan Pepián-Style Chicken
steps: Simmer the chicken in water 25 minutes, keeping the broth.
Toast the seeds and chilies, char the tomatoes, tomatillos and onion and blend with 500 ml broth.
Simmer the sauce with the cinnamon 15 minutes, add the chicken and cook 10 minutes.

recipes.title: Swiss Rösti
steps: Grate the potatoes coarsely and season.
Press into a hot pan with half the butter and cook 10 minutes until golden.
Flip using a plate, add the rest of the butter and cook 10 minutes more.

recipes.title: Swiss Älplermagronen
steps: Boil the potatoes and macaroni together until tender; drain.
Warm the cream, stir in the cheese and toss with the pasta.
Fry the onions in butter until golden and scatter over. Serve with applesauce.

recipes.title: Senegalese Thieboudienne-Style Fish and Rice

ingredients.name: Long-grain rice (broken rice if you can find it)

steps: Stuff slits in the fish with blended parsley and garlic and brown it.
Fry the onion and paste, add 1.5 litres water and the vegetables and simmer 20 minutes; add the fish for 10 minutes.
Lift out fish and vegetables and cook the rice in the broth 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Kenyan Githeri
steps: Fry the onion and carrot in the oil, add the curry powder and tomatoes.
Add the corn, beans and 200 ml water and simmer 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Colombian Arroz con Coco
steps: Simmer the coconut milk until it separates and browns.
Add the rice, sugar, raisins, salt and 300 ml water.
Cover and cook on low 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Colombian Ajiaco
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion and corn in 2 litres water 30 minutes; shred the chicken.
Add the potatoes and guascas and simmer 20 minutes until some break down.
Return the chicken and serve with cream, capers and avocado.

recipes.title: Venezuelan Pabellón Criollo
steps: Simmer the beef in water 1½ hours, then shred.
Fry the onion, pepper and garlic, add the tomatoes and beef and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with rice, warm beans and fried plantain.

recipes.title: Austrian Kaiserschmarrn
steps: Whisk the yolks, milk, flour and sugar; whisk the whites stiff and fold in.
Pour into a buttered pan, scatter raisins and cook 4 minutes; turn in pieces.
Tear into bite-size pieces with two forks, add more butter and caramelise. Dust with powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Austrian Wiener Schnitzel-Style Pork
steps: Season the cutlets, then dip in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in 1 cm hot oil 2 to 3 minutes per side, shaking the pan so the crumb puffs.
Drain and serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Costa Rican Arroz con Pollo
steps: Poach and shred the chicken or brown it in pieces.
Fry the vegetables with the achiote, add the rice, stock and sauce.
Cover and cook 20 minutes, then stir in the chicken and peas.

recipes.title: Syrian Fattoush Salad
steps: Toast or fry the pita until crisp and break up.
Chop the vegetables and herbs.
Dress with lemon, oil, sumac and salt and toss with the pita.

recipes.title: Salvadoran Pupusas with Curtido
steps: Mix the cabbage, carrot, vinegar, oregano and salt for the curtido and leave 1 hour.
Mix the masa and water to a soft dough.
Fill balls of dough with cheese and beans, flatten and cook on a hot griddle 4 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Palestinian Musakhan
steps: Roast the chicken with oil, allspice and salt at 200 °C for 45 minutes.
Cook the onions slowly in the oil with the sumac 30 minutes.
Spread onions on the breads, top with chicken and pine nuts and bake 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Polish Pierogi Ruskie
steps: Knead the flour, egg, water and salt and rest 30 minutes.
Mash the potatoes with the cheese and half the onion fried in butter.
Roll, cut, fill and seal.
Boil until they float plus 2 minutes; top with the rest of the onion.

recipes.title: Polish Żurek-Style Sour Rye Soup
steps: Simmer the sausage and potatoes in the stock 20 minutes.
Stir in the starter, garlic and marjoram and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with halved eggs and sliced sausage.

recipes.title: Czech Bramboráky (Potato Pancakes)
steps: Mix the potatoes with the eggs, garlic, flour, marjoram and salt.
Fry thin pancakes in hot oil 3 minutes per side until crisp.

recipes.title: Hungarian Lecsó
steps: Soften the onions in the lard.
Add the peppers and cook 10 minutes, then the tomatoes and paprika for 10 minutes.
Stir in beaten eggs at the end if you like.

recipes.title: Romanian Mămăligă with Cheese and Sour Cream
steps: Bring the salted water to a boil and whisk in the cornmeal.
Cook on low 15 to 20 minutes, stirring, until it pulls from the pan.
Stir in the butter and serve topped with cheese and sour cream.

recipes.title: Bulgarian Shopska Salad
steps: Chop the vegetables and dress with oil, vinegar and salt.
Grate the cheese generously over the top.

recipes.title: Croatian Squid Risotto
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and squid in the oil 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice, then add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for 18 minutes.
Stir in the chopped parsley (Croatian cooks often add squid ink for the black version).

recipes.title: Serbian Pljeskavica
steps: Mix the meats, grated onion, garlic, paprika and salt and chill 1 hour.
Shape 4 large thin patties.
Grill 5 to 6 minutes per side and serve in flatbreads with ajvar and onion.

recipes.title: Belgian Stoemp (Mash with Vegetables)
steps: Boil the potatoes and carrots together until soft.
Soften the leek in the butter.
Mash everything with the milk, nutmeg and salt.

recipes.title: Dutch Stamppot with Kale
steps: Boil the potatoes with the kale on top for 20 minutes.
Heat the sausage in simmering water 10 minutes.
Mash the potatoes and kale with butter, milk and salt and serve with sliced sausage.

recipes.title: Icelandic Plokkfiskur (Fish and Potato Hash)
steps: Poach the fish 5 minutes and flake.
Soften the onion in butter, stir in the flour, then the milk to a thick sauce.
Fold in the fish and chopped potatoes and season with pepper.

recipes.title: Argentine Provoleta
steps: Heat a cast-iron pan until very hot.
Cook the cheese 3 to 4 minutes per side until crusty and melting.
Sprinkle with oregano, chili and oil and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Brazilian Pão de Queijo
steps: Bring the milk, oil and salt to a boil and pour onto the tapioca; mix and cool 10 minutes.
Beat in the eggs, then the cheese.
Roll into 20 balls and bake at 200 °C for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Brazilian Feijoada-Style Black Bean Stew
steps: Brown the bacon, pork and sausage, then the onion and garlic.
Add the drained beans, bay and 2 litres water and simmer 2 hours until creamy.
Serve with rice, greens and orange slices.

recipes.title: Bolivian Salteñas-Style Baked Empanadas
steps: Make a dough of the flour, butter, raw egg, water and salt and rest 30 minutes.
Cook the beef, potatoes, peas and spices with a little water until thick and cool.
Fill rounds of dough with filling and chopped egg, seal with a rope edge.
Bake at 200 °C for 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Paraguayan Sopa Paraguaya (Corn Bread)
steps: Soften the onions in half the butter.
Beat the eggs, mix in the cornmeal, milk, crumbled cheese, onions, the rest of the butter, melted, baking powder and salt.
Bake in a greased dish at 190 °C for 40 minutes.

recipes.title: Uruguayan Chivito Sandwich
steps: Sear the steaks 1 minute per side, top with ham and cheese to melt.
Fry the eggs.
Fill the rolls with mayonnaise, lettuce, tomato, steak and egg.

recipes.title: Honduran Baleadas
steps: Warm the tortillas and the beans.
Spread with beans, sprinkle with cheese, add sour cream and egg and avocado if using.
Fold in half.

recipes.title: Nicaraguan Vigorón
steps: Boil the cassava 20 to 25 minutes until tender.
Toss the cabbage, tomato and onion with the vinegar and salt.
Serve cassava topped with salad and pork rinds.

recipes.title: Panamanian Sancocho
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion, garlic and oregano in 2 litres water 30 minutes.
Add the yam and simmer 20 minutes until soft and slightly thickened.
Stir in the chopped herbs.

recipes.title: Tunisian Lablabi (Chickpea Soup)
steps: Simmer the chickpeas, garlic and cumin in the stock 15 minutes.
Put torn bread in bowls and ladle the soup over.
Top with harissa, lemon, olive oil and a pinch of cumin.

recipes.title: Algerian Chakchouka
steps: Soften the onion and peppers in the oil 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, garlic and caraway and cook 10 minutes.
Make hollows, add the eggs, cover and cook 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Tanzanian Chipsi Mayai (Fries Omelette)
steps: Heat the fries in the oil in a nonstick pan.
Pour over the beaten eggs with salt and cook on low until set.
Flip and serve with a tomato and onion salad.

recipes.title: Ugandan Rolex (Chapati Egg Roll)
steps: Beat the eggs with the vegetables and salt.
Cook an omelette in the oil, lay a chapati on top and press.
Flip, roll up and slice.

recipes.title: Cameroonian Ndolé-Style Greens with Peanuts
steps: Boil the peanuts 15 minutes and blend to a paste.
Fry the onions, garlic and ginger, add the paste and 400 ml water and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the greens and shrimp and cook 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Ivorian Attiéké with Grilled Fish
steps: Steam the attiéké 5 minutes and fluff.
Grill the oiled, salted fish 4 minutes per side.
Serve with diced tomato, onion, chili and lime.

recipes.title: Malaysian Nasi Goreng Kampung
steps: Pound the shallots, garlic, chili and shrimp paste and fry until fragrant.
Add the rice and greens and stir-fry over high heat.
Season with soy and top with fried eggs.

recipes.title: Indonesian Gado-Gado
steps: Whisk the peanut butter, kecap manis, lime and warm water into a pourable sauce.
Arrange the vegetables, tofu and eggs on plates.
Pour over the sauce.

recipes.title: Cambodian Lok Lak
steps: Marinate the beef with the oyster sauce, soy and sugar 15 minutes.
Stir-fry over high heat 3 to 4 minutes.
Serve on lettuce, tomato and onion with a dip of lime juice, pepper and salt.

recipes.title: Lao Larb Gai
steps: Cook the chicken in a splash of water, breaking it up, 6 to 8 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the fish sauce, lime, rice powder, chili and shallots.
Fold in the herbs and serve with lettuce and sticky rice.

recipes.title: Mongolian Tsuivan (Fried Noodles with Beef)
steps: Make a firm dough of flour, water and salt, rest, roll thin and cut into noodles.
Stir-fry the beef and vegetables in the oil 5 minutes, add 150 ml water.
Lay the noodles on top, cover and steam 8 minutes, then toss.

recipes.title: Afghan Bolani (Stuffed Flatbread)
steps: Knead the flour, water and salt and rest 30 minutes.
Mix the mash with the spring onions, coriander, chili and salt.
Roll dough thin, fill half, fold and seal.
Fry in the oil 3 minutes per side.

recipes.title: Armenian Ghapama-Style Stuffed Pumpkin
steps: Cut a lid off the pumpkin and scoop out the seeds.
Mix the rice, fruit, nuts, honey, butter and cinnamon and fill the pumpkin.
Replace the lid and bake at 180 °C for 1½ hours until soft.

recipes.title: Azerbaijani Kuku with Herbs
steps: Chop the herbs and spring onions very finely and mix with the eggs, walnuts and salt.
Melt the butter in a pan, add the mixture and cook covered on low 15 minutes.
Flip and cook 5 minutes more.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Pol Sambol
steps: Rub everything together with your fingers and salt until pink and fragrant.
Serve with rice, curries or bread.

recipes.title: Bangladeshi Bhuna Khichuri
steps: Dry-roast the dal until fragrant and rinse with the rice.
Fry the onion, ginger and spices in the ghee.
Add the rice, dal and 900 ml hot water and cook covered 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Burmese Tomato Curry with Eggs
steps: Fry the eggs in the oil with turmeric until blistered; lift out.
Fry the onions and garlic until golden, add the paprika and tomatoes and cook 15 minutes.
Add the fish sauce and eggs and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Fijian Kokoda (Coconut Lime Fish)

ingredients.name: White fish fillets, very fresh, cubed

steps: Cover the fish with lime juice and salt and chill 1 to 2 hours until opaque.
Drain, then fold in the coconut cream, tomato, onion and chili.

recipes.title: New Zealand Pavlova with Kiwi
steps: Whisk the whites stiff, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Fold in the vinegar and cornstarch.
Spread into a 20 cm round on baking paper and bake at 120 °C for 75 minutes; cool in the oven.
Top with whipped cream and fruit.

recipes.title: Samoan Panipopo (Coconut Buns)
steps: Knead the flour, yeast, sugar, milk, egg, butter and salt and rise 1 hour.
Shape 12 buns in a dish and rise 30 minutes.
Pour over the coconut milk mixed with the extra sugar and bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Haitian Diri ak Pwa (Rice and Beans)
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil, add the beans with their liquid and simmer 5 minutes.
Add the rice, thyme, whole pepper and water to 2 cm above the rice.
Cover and cook on low 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Dominican Habichuelas Guisadas
steps: Fry the onion, pepper and garlic, then the tomato paste.
Add the beans with some liquid and the pumpkin and simmer 20 minutes, mashing the pumpkin to thicken.
Stir in the coriander.

recipes.title: Guyanese Cook-Up Rice
steps: Brown the chicken with the onion and garlic.
Add the rice, peas, coconut milk, thyme, pepper and 500 ml water.
Cover and cook on low 25 to 30 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid absorbed.

recipes.title: Roasted Cauliflower and Turmeric Soup
steps: Roast the cauliflower and onion with the oil and spices at 210 °C for 25 minutes.
Simmer with the stock and coconut milk 10 minutes and blend.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken and Wild Rice Soup
steps: Soften the vegetables in the butter.
Add the stock, rice and chicken and simmer 40 minutes; shred the chicken.
Stir in the cream.

recipes.title: Roasted Carrot and Ginger Soup
steps: Roast the carrots and onion in the oil at 210 °C for 25 minutes.
Simmer with the ginger and stock 10 minutes and blend.
Swirl with yogurt.

recipes.title: Thai Pumpkin Coconut Soup
steps: Fry the paste in a splash of coconut milk.
Add the pumpkin, the rest of the milk and stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Blend and finish with lime and coriander.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Avgolemono Soup
steps: Simmer the orzo in the stock 10 minutes and add the chicken.
Whisk the eggs with the lemon juice and slowly whisk in a ladle of hot stock.
Stir the mixture into the pot off the heat until silky; add dill.

recipes.title: Charred Corn and Tomato Salad
steps: Char the corn in a hot pan or grill and cut off the kernels.
Toss with halved tomatoes, sliced onion, lime and oil.
Top with feta and basil.

recipes.title: Crunchy Asian Slaw with Peanuts
steps: Shred the cabbage and carrots finely.
Whisk the vinegar, soy, oil and honey.
Toss and top with spring onions and peanuts.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Honey Walnut Bowls
steps: Toast the walnuts.
Spoon the yogurt into bowls and top with walnuts, honey and cinnamon.

recipes.title: No-Bake Chocolate Peanut Butter Bars
steps: Mix the crumbs, butter, peanut butter and sugar and press into a lined 20 cm tin.
Melt the chocolate and spread over.
Chill 2 hours and cut into 16.

recipes.title: Baked Rice Pudding with Nutmeg
steps: Put the rice, milk and sugar in a buttered dish and dot with butter.
Grate over the nutmeg.
Bake at 150 °C for 2 hours, stirring once after 30 minutes.
